name: AstroQuest
summary:
Everyone can become an astronaut and embark on an **exciting space journey**. Explore the wonders of the solar system, from the Sun to distant Neptune—all from the comfort of your couch. 

With its simple and minimalist interface, AstroQuest is designed for both professionals and kids, making space exploration accessible to everyone. Virtually visit your favorite celestial objects and float through space, immersing yourself in the awe of worlds where humans are yet to set foot.
